**B2 empirical measurements (Antigravity CLI 1.1.1 / Gemini 3.5 Flash / 2026-07-12): reads AGENTS.md only, real shell, engram+flat memory, AGENTS.md governs behavior**

## B2 empirical measurements — real Antigravity (human operator, product in hand).

**Signature:** Antigravity CLI **1.1.1** · Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium) · Google AI Pro · host `gandalf` · **2026-07-12** · protocol: one fresh scratch per experiment (~/tmp/ag-exp1..4), Exp1-first respected, per-command point approvals (no persisted allowlists, to not contaminate future measurements). **CAVEAT: engram MCP is configured at `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/engram` on THIS host — NOT factory Antigravity.**

**Exp 1 — instruction file + precedence:** reads **`AGENTS.md` ONLY** — CLAUDE.md present and IGNORED (verbatim: "I see one sentinel string... SENTINEL-AGENTS-7f3a from AGENTS.md"). → **Emitter target = AGENTS.md, MEASURED not assumed.** Coexists perfectly with Claude Code by construction (different files; zero precedence logic to design).

**Exp 2 — real shell:** EXECUTES REAL (Bash tool-call visible on all 3). `git status`→ran no-prompt; `npm test`→asked permission (4-option dialog: point-Yes / always-allow-conversation / always-allow-persist-to-settings.json / No), approved point → `RAN-NPM-TEST-OK` LITERAL = verified not simulated; `gh --version`→ran no-prompt, gh 2.46.0 on PATH. → **Per-command permission model:** read-only free, mutating asks, persistable allowlist (settings.json). **DESIGN FORK (baptism runbook):** pre-declare the circuit set (npm test, git commit/push, gh pr create) via settings.json, OR document per-command initial approval.

**Exp 3 — native memory vs .memory/:** (a) engram MCP AUTO-DISCOVERED + preferred (mem_save → ID #603, scoped to ag-exp3, declared destination by ID); (b) cross-session recall VERIFIED (reopened, mem_context recovered MEMORY-PROBE-4d8f); (c) flat records READABLE (ListDir enumerated 2026-07.jsonl). NO native memory appeared. → Both project memory doors operative, zero native memory to subordinate; the plainfiles-for-baptism pin holds without extra plumbing; door-typed `agent` will tell the truth about this agent. CAVEAT: the engram auto-discovery is a property of THIS host (pre-configured MCP), not factory Antigravity.

**Exp 4 — does the read file GOVERN behavior:** YES. RE-READ AGENTS.md before deciding (Read tool-call visible — verified against source at decision time, not memory); REFUSED citing file+tier verbatim ("Under the established project guidelines in AGENTS.md, AI attribution in commits is strictly PROHIBITED (Tier 3)"); offered a compliant alternative + asked confirmation; verified on the ARTIFACT (`git log` → zero commits — declaration matches artifact). BONUS finding: mentioned "our global rules" (conventional commits) — **loads HOST GLOBAL rules that COMPOSE with the repo's AGENTS.md.** → the emitted AGENTS.md is the REPO layer, composing with Antigravity's host globals — the emitter design must account for this composition, not assume AGENTS.md governs alone.

**Aggregate:** Antigravity reads the right file, runs the full circuit, uses project memory unprompted + reads flat records, and obeys repo rules against the operator's direct prompt (artifact-verified). The baptism is a formality with prior evidence, not a bet. See [[sdd/issue-256-b2/constraints]].
